newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-GRAF LOOKING SET FOR AUTUMN COMEBACK.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-GRAF LOOKING SET FOR AUTUMN COMEBACK.

text.p: Steffi Graf was quoted on Tuesday as saying she is on the way to recovery from an operation on her knee and could be fit enough to play again by late autumn.

"My main goal is to get fit for the 1998 grand slam tournaments," Graf told Frankfurt's Sunny weekly magazine. "If everything goes well I should be able to play again in late autumn and be there for the Master of Champions tournament in Frankfurt," she said.
The former world number one slipped to fifth place in the rankings this week, her worst position for 11 years, after she missed Wimbledon because of an operation last month.

"Immediately afterwards was a bit difficult. But now I can move without pain," said the 28-year-old German, who is recuperating in a clinic in Vienna and will not be able to defend her U.S. Open title in August.
Graf, who last month said she would have no problem ending her career, said the founding of her Steffi Graf Sport company showed she was preparing herself for life after tennis.
"The adjustment will certainly not be easy, the alternatives must develop themselves. But I won't fall into a hole," she said.
